name: Eda Hideaki
source:
As a child, he lived in the city, which is where he met Nazuna. His parents were transferred due to their jobs, and he had to leave the city for a rural area. Soon after moving, he becomes close friends with Kazan, Madoka, Eru, and Sakino. After moving, Hideaki became very carefree due to his new friends and the laid-back nature of the town.

[from [url=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Orange_Pocket]Wikipedia[/url]]
